findings.description: The policy grants the deployment user ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on every resource. This provides broad data access and modification capabilities and can enable privilege escalation through allowed service actions, contrary to least privilege.

The encrypted IAM secret access-key material is exported through an output that is not marked sensitive. It can therefore be displayed by Terraform or exposed to output consumers; the ciphertext remains credential material because possession of its decryption key enables recovery of the access-key secret.
